title: achetaria erecta

It is known for its potential health benefits, including its use as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antihypertensive agent. The bioactive constituents of Achetaria erecta have been found to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
